questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy's core purpose or goal is indeed climate action. The policy outlines a comprehensive plan to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and transition to a zero-carbon community by 2040. This is evident in the policy's focus on three key areas: stationary energy, transport, and waste. The policy aims to drive emissions reductions in these areas through a series of five-yearly action plans. These plans will set medium-term targets and map out priority projects and programs. The policy also emphasizes the importance of monitoring progress towards the zero-carbon vision and adjusting strategies as necessary. Furthermore, the policy acknowledges the need for strong advocacy to achieve its objectives, indicating a commitment to influencing broader policy and social change in support of climate action.

quote.content: The Framework reflects our focus on driving emissions reductions across the three key sources of the Moreland community’s greenhouse gas emissions: stationary energy, transport and waste.

questions.answer: The document indeed calls for rapid and urgent action on climate change. questions.text: Does the document give specific timeframes for its intended actions on climate?
questions.answer: The document does provide specific timeframes for its intended actions on climate. It outlines a 'Moreland Zero Carbon – 2040 Framework' which aims to drive emissions reductions across three target areas: energy transition, sustainable transport, and waste and consumption. The framework sets key priorities for the first five years (2020 – 2025) and will be reviewed and reset every five years. Five-yearly Zero Carbon Action Plans will be developed to set medium-term targets and map out priority projects and programs. The document also mentions an annual progress report to the council and a four-yearly community GHG emissions profile. However, it is important to note that while the document provides these timeframes, it also acknowledges the dynamic nature of the social, political, and technological context, suggesting that the specifics of initiatives and advocacy priorities may not be feasible to define for the entire 20-year period.

quote.content: Five-yearly Zero Carbon Action Plans will be developed to set medium-term targets and map out priority projects and programs. This Moreland Zero Carbon – 2040 Framework defines the key priorities for driving emissions reductions across the three target areas: energy transition, sustainable transport and waste and consumption over the first five years (2020 – 2025) and beyond. The key priorities for action and advocacy outcomes within the Framework will be reviewed each five years and re-set for the following five-years.
